zh-CN.title: Fufu 奔跑轨迹归位
items: Fufu 的奔跑坐标改为以居中气泡为基准
角色只沿气泡下边框移动，不再从选项卡左下角出现
扬尘轨迹同步收拢至气泡宽度

en.title: Re-aligned Fufu's capsule run
items: Fufu's run is now anchored to the centered bubble
The character stays on the lower bubble edge instead of entering from the card corner
The dust trail is constrained to the bubble width
